findings.title: The guard plugin runs during vite build: its load hook answers asset imports with a dev URL, so a built bundle references /src/... and the asset is never emitted.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.ts:450-495 (reads === url at 481-485, reached via assetsInclude at 470 or ?url); no apply: serve or command check. Real vite.build() on a fixture: const c="/src/logo.svg", no dist/assets/logo-*.svg.
findings.consequence: Any asset import would 404 in production. Latent today: the app imports no assets.

findings.title: Killing the top-level vitest run leaves the pool worker running race cases and togglers; the toggler watches only its direct parent.
findings.evidence: kill -9 of the backgrounded npx vitest: the forks.js worker kept spawning race cases for 30+ s. ts/vite.config.test.ts:63-71 ppid check.
findings.consequence: The stated no-orphan guarantee holds only one hop up.
